# dokku_app (Resource)

Manages a Dokku application. This resource enables the configuration and deployment of applications on a Dokku host, supporting environment variables, domains, buildpacks, port mapping, and Docker networks.

## Example Usage

### Attach apps to a Docker network

Apps on the same Dokku network can reach each other via Docker DNS as `http://<app>.web:<port>`. Optionally set `tld` so aliases become `http://<app>.web.<tld>:<port>`:

```terraform
resource "dokku_app" "geoip" {
  name       = "geoip"

  networks {
    attach_post_create = "militia-media"
    tld                = "internal"
  }
}

resource "dokku_app" "api" {
  name = "api"

  networks {
    attach_post_create = "militia-media"
    tld                = "internal"
  }

  config_vars = {
    GEOIP_API_URL = "http://geoip.web.internal:8080"
  }
}
```

The provider creates named networks if they do not exist (`network:create`), sets network properties via `network:set` (including `tld`), and rebuilds on change so attachments and aliases apply.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Dokku application.

### Optional

- `buildpacks` (List of String) List of buildpacks to be used when deploying the application. These can be URLs to custom buildpacks or shorthand names for official Heroku buildpacks.
- `config_vars` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables to set for the application. These are exposed to the application at runtime.
- `domains` (Set of String) List of domains to be associated with the application.
- `locked` (Boolean) (Not yet implemented) Whether the application is locked for deployment. When true, deploys to this application will be blocked.
- `networks` (Block List, Max: 1) Docker network attachment and alias settings for the app. Creates named networks if missing. See https://dokku.com/docs/networking/network/ (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--networks))
- `nginx_bind_address_ipv4` (String) The IPv4 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '0.0.0.0'.
- `nginx_bind_address_ipv6` (String) The IPv6 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '::'.
- `ports` (Set of String) Set of port mappings for the application. Each mapping should be in the format 'scheme:hostPort:containerPort' (e.g., 'https:443:8080').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Optional:

- `attach_post_create` (String) Network attached after container create (before start). Enables DNS between apps as `<app>.web` (or `<app>.web.<tld>` when tld is set).
- `attach_post_deploy` (String) Network attached after a successful deploy.
- `initial_network` (String) Network used as the container's initial/primary network.
- `tld` (String) TLD suffixed to the app network alias for all attached networks (e.g. `internal` → `<app>.web.internal`). Not a Docker network name.
